title: Remove left-side bulk-select checkbox from task list rows (keep only completion checkbox)

requirements.text: In the List view task rows, remove the left-side (bulk-select) checkbox (the first/left checkbox marked in red in the provided screenshot) so that each task row shows only one checkbox: the task completion checkbox.

quotes: first means left side first (marked in red color)

acceptanceCriteria: In List view, each task row renders exactly one checkbox control (the completion checkbox).
The leftmost/bulk-select checkbox is not rendered anywhere in the task list rows.
There is no duplicate checkbox UI in the task list rows (matches the screenshot intent).
The remaining checkbox continues to toggle task completion/reopen as it did previously.

requirements.text: Disable or remove bulk-selection wiring from the List view so the removed bulk-select checkbox is not passed/rendered via props (e.g., stop passing selection props into task-row components) and the bulk actions bar does not appear due to leftover selection state.

quotes: Remove the left-side (bulk-select) checkbox from each task row, leaving only the task completion checkbox; ensure no duplicate checkboxes remain in list view.

acceptanceCriteria: Task rows do not receive or depend on selection props for rendering a selection checkbox.
The bulk actions selection UI does not appear as a result of any default/leftover selection state after this change.
No user-facing text regressions are introduced; any visible labels remain in English.

constraints: Frontend paths listed as immutable must not be edited (compose UI components instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing an alternative bulk-selection UI (e.g., row-click to select, select-all, multi-select keyboard shortcuts).
Any of the other requested upgrades (comments, completed_at, duration_hours, animations, card layout changes) beyond this first one-by-one step.
